responsibility: Owns the Cranelift backend’s DWARF debug-info construction state and exposes the high-level API for defining compile units, namespaces, functions, and statics. It initializes unit-wide encoding and line-program settings, tracks file and namespace caches, manages function-scoped debug contexts and range lists, and coordinates subordinate type, line, emission, and unwind support within the debuginfo module.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is the metadata-owning entry point for DWARF generation: it builds and caches compile-unit, file, namespace, function, static, line-program, and unwind/debug state. Its boundary is descriptive debug emission, not runtime calling conventions, codegen driver setup, intrinsic lowering, or optimization organization.
